positions.commentary: The speaker suggests avoiding Microsoft when it becomes egregiously overvalued, distinguishing this from simply being overvalued.
The speaker cites Google buying YouTube and Android as examples of great management teams surprising to the upside.
The speaker cites Amazon morphing into web services as an example of a great business surprising to the upside.
The speaker mentions a parking business near an airport that got swept up by Uber, noting it had great fundamentals but was affected by the acquisition.
